artifact_observations.reasoning: The wood grain texture appears slightly repetitive and 'painted-on' rather than having deep physical depth, particularly on the front-facing ends of the beams in the lower center.
The vertical lines of the forklift mast show slight waviness and lack perfect geometric straightness, suggesting minor generation instability in rigid mechanical parts.
The alignment of the background stacks becomes slightly inconsistent with linear perspective rules, appearing to lean or merge subtly.

To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the overlapping wood planks and ensure the forklift is correctly grounded in the scene depth.
To check for fusion artifacts where individual planks in the dense stacks might be merging into each other without clear boundaries.
To assess the realism of the wood textures and lighting consistency across the complex geometry of the stacks.
